d: Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal addressed queries regarding the Quad summit held in Manila and recent critical remarks by the US Commission on International Religious Freedom. Responding to allegations from the USCIRF, Jaiswal dismissed the body's credibility, stating, "we see it as a biased organization with a blatantly political agenda, and I don't think an organization which is so prejudiced needs to be taken seriously."
